exposure: born very preterm (below 30 weeks of gestation)
surgical closure of patent ductus arteriosus
cohort: A national cohort of 290 surviving Swiss children born below 30 weeks of gestation in the year 2000, assessed at age 12 years.
finding: The average self- and parent-reported HRQoL of former preterms was similar to Swiss norms, however, surgical closure of patent ductus arteriosus, attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder, and severe neurodevelopment impairment were identified as predictors of poorer HRQoL.
